data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic root 'mar' meaning 'bitter' and the suffix '-jeta'. The name may have originated from the Old Slavic word for 'majestic'. It may also be related to the Old Slavic word for 'bittern'. The name Marjeta carries the meaning “Majestic, small bittern” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marjeta usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, small bittern and live with faith, good character and purpose.
